account_mail_outbox_sealed_check.name: account_mail_outbox_sealed_check
account_mail_outbox_sealed_check.value: ("account_mail_outbox"."ciphertext" is null and "account_mail_outbox"."iv" is null and "account_mail_outbox"."tag" is null and "account_mail_outbox"."key_version" is null) or ("account_mail_outbox"."ciphertext" is not null and "account_mail_outbox"."iv" is not null and "account_mail_outbox"."tag" is not null and "account_mail_outbox"."key_version" is not null)

configuration_migration_preview_bounds_c.name: configuration_migration_preview_bounds_check
configuration_migration_preview_bounds_c.value: "configuration_migration_preview"."kind" in ('migration','credentials') and "configuration_migration_preview"."intent_fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and octet_length("configuration_migration_preview"."ciphertext") <= 1572864 and length("configuration_migration_preview"."iv") = 16 and length("configuration_migration_preview"."tag") = 24 and "configuration_migration_preview"."expires_at" > "configuration_migration_preview"."created_at" and "configuration_migration_preview"."expires_at" <= "configuration_migration_preview"."created_at" + interval '10 minutes'

configuration_fence_status_check.name: configuration_fence_status_check
configuration_fence_status_check.value: ("data_manager"."configuration_fence"."status" = 'prepared' AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."outcome" IS NULL AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."settled_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_manager"."configuration_fence"."status" = 'settled' AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."outcome" IN ('applied','unused','contained') AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("data_manager"."configuration_fence"."status" = 'refused' AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."outcome" IS NULL AND "data_manager"."configuration_fence"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)

job_admitted_at_idx.name: job_admitted_at_idx
job_admitted_at_idx.where: "data_manager"."job"."finished_at" IS NULL OR ("data_manager"."job"."execution_admission" IS NOT NULL AND "data_manager"."job"."released_at" IS NULL)

job_execution_row_check.name: job_execution_row_check
job_execution_row_check.value: ("data_manager"."job"."execution_admission" IS NULL) = ("data_manager"."job"."execution_progress" IS NULL) AND ("data_manager"."job"."execution_admission" IS NOT NULL OR "data_manager"."job"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("data_manager"."job"."execution_completion" IS NULL OR "data_manager"."job"."execution_admission" IS NOT NULL) AND ("data_manager"."job"."released_at" IS NULL OR "data_manager"."job"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

data_subject_request_locator_ciphertext_.name: data_subject_request_locator_ciphertext_check
data_subject_request_locator_ciphertext_.value: ("data_subject_request"."locator_ciphertext" is null and "data_subject_request"."locator_iv" is null and "data_subject_request"."locator_tag" is null and "data_subject_request"."locator_key_version" is null) or ("data_subject_request"."locator_ciphertext" is not null and "data_subject_request"."locator_iv" is not null and "data_subject_request"."locator_tag" is not null and "data_subject_request"."locator_key_version" is not null)

data_subject_request_identity_check.name: data_subject_request_identity_check
data_subject_request_identity_check.value: ("data_subject_request"."identity_method" is null and "data_subject_request"."identity_verified_at" is null) or ("data_subject_request"."identity_method" in ('account_session', 'manual') and "data_subject_request"."identity_verified_at" is not null)

extension_setting_value_check.name: extension_setting_value_check
extension_setting_value_check.value: ("extension_setting"."value" is not null and "extension_setting"."ciphertext" is null and "extension_setting"."iv" is null and "extension_setting"."tag" is null and "extension_setting"."key_version" is null) or ("extension_setting"."value" is null and "extension_setting"."ciphertext" is not null and "extension_setting"."iv" is not null and "extension_setting"."tag" is not null and "extension_setting"."key_version" is not null)

installed_extension_standalone_provenanc.name: installed_extension_standalone_provenance_check
installed_extension_standalone_provenanc.value: "installed_extension"."installation_kind" <> 'standalone' or coalesce(("installed_extension"."source_trust" = 'community' and "installed_extension"."id" ~ '^local-[0-9a-f-]{36}$' and jsonb_typeof("installed_extension"."provenance") = 'object' and "installed_extension"."provenance"->>'kind' in ('artifact','source','uploaded-artifact') and "installed_extension"."provenance"->>'contentDigest' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),false)

labeled_place_field_contributors_version.name: labeled_place_field_contributors_version_check
labeled_place_field_contributors_version.value: ("labeled_place"."field_contributors" is null) = ("labeled_place"."field_contributors_version" is null) and ("labeled_place"."field_contributors_version" is null or "labeled_place"."field_contributors_version" = 1)

personal_vehicle_ev_version_check.name: personal_vehicle_ev_version_check
personal_vehicle_ev_version_check.value: ("personal_vehicle"."ev" is null) = ("personal_vehicle"."ev_version" is null) and ("personal_vehicle"."ev_version" is null or "personal_vehicle"."ev_version" = 1)

platform_configuration_preview_bounds_ch.name: platform_configuration_preview_bounds_check
platform_configuration_preview_bounds_ch.value: length("platform_configuration_preview"."operation_key") between 1 and 128 and "platform_configuration_preview"."request_fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "platform_configuration_preview"."preview_fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "platform_configuration_preview"."auth_policy_revision" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and octet_length("platform_configuration_preview"."preview"::text) <= 131072 and jsonb_typeof("platform_configuration_preview"."preview") = 'object' and "platform_configuration_preview"."expires_at" > "platform_configuration_preview"."created_at" and "platform_configuration_preview"."expires_at" <= "platform_configuration_preview"."created_at" + interval '10 minutes' and (("platform_configuration_preview"."consumed_at" is null) = ("platform_configuration_preview"."consumed_by_job_id" is null)) and ("platform_configuration_preview"."retired_at" is null or ("platform_configuration_preview"."consumed_at" is not null and "platform_configuration_preview"."retired_at" >= "platform_configuration_preview"."consumed_at"))

saved_place_field_contributors_version_c.name: saved_place_field_contributors_version_check
saved_place_field_contributors_version_c.value: ("saved_place"."field_contributors" is null) = ("saved_place"."field_contributors_version" is null) and ("saved_place"."field_contributors_version" is null or "saved_place"."field_contributors_version" = 1)

share_link_snapshot_version_check.name: share_link_snapshot_version_check
share_link_snapshot_version_check.value: ("share_link"."snapshot" is null) = ("share_link"."snapshot_version" is null) and ("share_link"."snapshot_version" is null or "share_link"."snapshot_version" = 1)

transit_credential_preview_authorization.name: transit_credential_preview_authorization_check
transit_credential_preview_authorization.value: ("transit_credential_preview"."authorization_ciphertext" is null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_iv" is null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_tag" is null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_key_version" is null) or ("transit_credential_preview"."authorization_ciphertext" is not null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_iv" is not null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_tag" is not null and "transit_credential_preview"."authorization_key_version" is not null)
